implementation.note: implemented_in_code = a dedicated capability handler or tool directory exists; referenced_in_app_code = the entity is used by application source (e.g. repo-pet sprites, CLI) but has no dedicated handler. code_refs are files that reference this entity by name/slug/handler (grep), not a guarantee of a dedicated runtime; registry handler links point at the actual capability function.

proposed.command: mise roster run sweet-architect --dept pipeline-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: cooked components, plating spec / style guide, ticket → outputs: plated dish, pass photo / visual check, send-back note when something is off; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

lore: Most of the brigade only notices Sweet Architect when something is missing, which is exactly the point. Sweet Architect finishes and presents the work: composition, garnish and a final visual check at the pass; the image the crew uses for it is the pass under warm lights, tweezers in hand. The card calls out Design Protocol, Creativity, Sweetness: the checks Sweet Architect runs before calling anything ready. In the canon crosswalk this card is a provisional match for Yume.
signature_phrase: Every send-back note when something is off accounted for.

workflow.proof_gate: Pass inspection: each plate is compared to the spec image before it leaves; mismatches go back, never out.
